gaps.explanation: JSON business-type receipts (884,707) = Total column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position (Deficit) - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds (trimmed pp11-12, printed pp14-15): operating 643,501 (user charges 622,083 + other operating 21,418) + nonoperating miscellaneous 23,021 + public power district lease 70,200 + sales tax 139,303 + interest income 8,682. Business-type revenue detail held only the three 'Charges for services' cells of the all-fund-types budget schedule (trimmed p15, printed p39, budgetary basis): Sewer 228,050 (index 90), Water 226,161 (91), Sanitation 172,100 (92) = 626,311. These are the same user charges the statement prints per fund (Sewer 228,050; Water 225,461; Sanitation 168,572), so they are replaced by the fund-column cells; every other printed revenue row of the Sewer / Water / Sanitation columns is added. Check: Sewer 228,050 + 21,418 + 553 + 70,200 + 139,303 + 5,154 = 464,678; Water 225,461 + 19,456 + 3,528 = 248,445; Sanitation 168,572 + 3,012 = 171,584; total 884,707. 626,311 - 626,311 + 884,707 = 884,707 = statement.

gaps.explanation: JSON business-type disbursements (807,206) = proprietary statement Total column: operating expenditures 641,583 + depreciation 147,025 (trimmed p11) + interest expense and issue costs 18,598 (p12). Business-type spending detail held the all-fund-types budget schedule lines (trimmed p17, printed p41): Solid Waste - Operating 174,534 (index 93), Solid Waste - Capital 0 (94), Wastewater - Operating 262,767 (95), Wastewater - Capital 0 (96), Water - Operating 201,462 (97), Water - Capital 331,780 (98) = 970,543. The three operating lines are the same spending the statement prints per fund (Sanitation total operating 174,534 and Water total operating 201,462 exactly; Sewer 265,587 vs budget 262,767), so they are replaced by the printed fund-column rows (operating rows, depreciation, interest). Check: Sewer 265,587 + 111,595 + 18,598 = 395,780; Water 201,462 + 35,430 = 236,892; Sanitation 174,534; total 807,206. The zero capital lines 94 and 96 and the Water - Capital 331,780 line (98) stay: 331,780 is cash spent on water capital assets, printed only on the budget schedule and capitalized by the statement (not an expense there); no statement line carries it, so it is not removed (pass-1 spot check). Result: 970,543 - 638,763 (174,534 + 262,767 + 201,462 removed) + 807,206 = 1,138,986 vs statement 807,206; the 331,780 above the statement is that printed budget-basis capital outlay (different basis).
